_about: English template set for the V1.6 deterministic interpretation layer.
Every entry is a COMPLETE, PARAMETERISED sentence. Nothing here is a
fragment to be concatenated with another fragment, because a translator
cannot reorder what Python has already glued together (Part 23).
One semantic state resolves to exactly one sentence. There are no
alternative phrasings and no random selection: Part 28 requires
The wording is deliberately cautious. These sentences describe what the
engine CALCULATED, not what will happen to a person, and several of
them exist specifically to say that the calculation is weak.

appendix.heading: Sources and rules used
appendix.no_sources: No textual sources were used for this section; every factor in it rests on conventional mappings.

confidence.HIGH: The underlying calculations are stable for the birth data supplied.
confidence.MEDIUM: The underlying calculations are reasonably stable, though some inputs are not fully determined by the birth data supplied.
confidence.LOW: This assessment depends on factors that are sensitive to the exact birth time, or on rules with weak textual support, and should be treated with caution.
confidence.UNRESOLVED: There is not enough settled evidence to say how much weight this assessment can bear.

contradiction.both_present: Several factors support activity in this area, while other factors indicate obstacles or delay. Both are listed below and neither cancels the other.
contradiction.supportive_only: The factors found in this area point in one direction.
contradiction.challenging_only: The factors found in this area indicate obstacles or delay.
contradiction.both_present_summary: The factors found in this area point in both directions; neither cancels the other.

document.title: Structured astrological analysis for {date}
document.generated_for: Analysis calculated for {date} using the {profile} methodology profile.
document.disclaimer: This document is generated by deterministic calculation and template substitution. It reports what a rule engine computed from a birth chart; it is not a prediction of events, not advice, and not a validated account of any tradition.

activation.STRONGLY_ACTIVE: This area is strongly activated in the period examined, with indications present in the birth chart, the running dasha and current transits.
activation.ACTIVE: This area is active in the period examined, with indications present in the birth chart and the running dasha.
activation.BACKGROUND: This area shows a standing indication in the birth chart that nothing in the current period is activating.
activation.MIXED: This area is active in the period examined, and the indications point in both directions.
activation.INACTIVE: This area shows no indication that the current methodology profile admits.

evidence.house_lord_dignified: The lord of the {house} is {dignity} in {sign}, which the engine counts as supportive for this area.
evidence.house_lord_debilitated: The lord of the {house} is debilitated in {sign}, which the engine counts as a difficulty for this area.
evidence.house_lord_in_dusthana: The lord of the {house} occupies the {occupied_house}, one of the difficult houses.
evidence.house_lord_well_placed: The lord of the {house} occupies the {occupied_house}.
evidence.house_lord_combust: The lord of the {house} is combust, standing close to Surya.
evidence.benefic_aspects_house: {planet}, a natural benefic, casts an aspect on the {house}.
evidence.malefic_aspects_house: {planet}, a natural malefic, casts an aspect on the {house}.
evidence.karaka_dignified: {planet}, the natural significator for this area, is {dignity}.
evidence.karaka_afflicted: {planet}, the natural significator for this area, is {state}.
evidence.house_lord_shadbala: The lord of the {house} reaches {ratio} times the six-fold strength the source text requires for it.
evidence.sarvashtakavarga_bindus: The {house} holds {bindus} sarvashtakavarga points, against an engine reference level of {reference}.
evidence.yoga_present: {yoga} is present in the chart, with the status {status}.
evidence.dasha_lord_activates_house: The running {level} belongs to {planet}, which rules or occupies the {houses} relevant to this area.
evidence.dasha_lord_carries_yoga: {planet}, lord of the running {level}, takes part in {yoga}.
evidence.over_natal_house: {planet} is currently transiting the {house} of the birth chart.
evidence.over_house_from_natal_moon: {planet} is currently transiting the {house} counted from the natal Chandra.
evidence.conjunct_natal_point: Transiting {planet} shares a sign with natal {target}.
evidence.graha_drishti_to_natal_point: Transiting {planet} casts an aspect on natal {target}.

methodology.statement: This assessment uses the {profile} methodology profile.
methodology.domain_mapping_coverage: Of the factors linking chart positions to this area, {qualified} of {total} have a located textual source.
methodology.not_validated: No rule, mapping or weighting used here is tradition-validated. Located textual support means a passage has been found and read, not that the reading has been confirmed by a scholar.

profile.strict: Only factors whose link to this area of life has a located textual source are used.
profile.standard: Documented methodology is used, including mappings that are conventional rather than textually sourced.
profile.experimental: Explicitly unverified rules are included. Results under this profile carry less weight than under the others.

reliability.birth_time_precision: The birth time was taken as precise to {seconds} seconds.
reliability.sensitivity_not_computed: Birth-time sensitivity was not calculated for this chart, so nothing below has been shown to be stable against small changes in the recorded time.
reliability.varga_unstable: The {chart} divisional chart changes within the uncertainty of the birth time supplied.
reliability.lagna_unstable: The rising sign itself changes within the uncertainty of the birth time supplied, so every conclusion in this document is affected.
reliability.boundary_unresolved: {planet} sits at a boundary that the calculation does not resolve, so its sign or nakshatra is uncertain.
reliability.depends_on_unstable_varga: This conclusion relies partly on {chart}, which changes within the uncertainty of the birth time supplied.
reliability.schema_mismatch: This document was rendered from prediction schema {found}, while the renderer was written against {expected}, so some sections may not correspond

safety.health_scope: This section reports calculated indications at the level of a general life area only. It is not a medical assessment, contains no diagnosis or prognosis, and should not be used in place of qualified medical advice.
safety.longevity_scope: This section reports calculated factors traditionally associated with the eighth house. It contains no statement about lifespan, no date, and no prediction of death, and none can be derived from it.

silence.insufficient_validated_evidence: Insufficient validated evidence for this area under the {profile} profile.
silence.no_natal_indication: The birth chart shows no indication for this area that the {profile} profile admits.
silence.transit_without_promise: Transits currently touch the houses associated with this area, but the birth chart shows no standing indication for them to activate, so nothing is reported.
silence.excluded_by_profile: {count} rule or mapping(s) bearing on this area were excluded by the {profile} profile.

timing.window_with_peak: Activation is calculated from {start} to {end}, with the strongest calculated trigger around {peak}.
timing.window_without_peak: Activation is calculated from {start} to {end}. No single strongest point was identified within it.
timing.no_window: No timing window could be calculated for this area from the periods and transits available.
timing.dasha_stack: The running periods are the {mahadasha} mahadasha, the {antardasha} antardasha and the {pratyantardasha} pratyantardasha.
timing.event_candidate: A {event_type} candidate falls in this window, at activation level {activation}.
